post_clip.description: A person is standing close to a decorated Christmas tree in a hallway, holding what appears to be a lighter or small flame source near the lower branches; the tree is adorned with lights and flammable decorations (tinsel, ribbons), creating high fire risk. The posture and focused attention on the base of the tree suggest deliberate ignition attempt—consistent with arson behavior. No visible smoke yet, but the action matches the expected anomaly pattern: small fire starting from one point with a person nearby using an ignition source.
